These insights are precious — they help us aim higher for what’s next.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/3eca2906b5ffca4c222fbd7312fee49362392825.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔮 What’s next?[/h3][p]To explain our vision more clearly, let’s take the example of [b]Captain Tsubasa[/b] ⚽.

It helps us tremendously and gets us closer to giving you that extra episode.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/5368068031023336b987915d0fe2a2afa731d980.png"][/img][/p][h3]🗣️ Putting the community at the heart of B.E.S.T 2[/h3][p]We want to involve the community [b]even more[/b] in the development of [b]B.E.S.T 2[/b]. Your opinions, wishes, and ideas will guide our choices so you get [b]the game you truly hope for[/b].[/p][p]And to start right now, here’s our first open question:[/p][h2]
👉 In Season 1, you took part in a football (soccer) tournament. For the next arc, what would you prefer?[/h2][list][*][p][b]⚽ Keep this type of sports events outside of the B.E.S.T competition?[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🏀 Try a different sport for a change of pace?[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🎯 Or focus solely on the B.E.S.T competition and leave the sports aside?[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We can’t wait to read your answers and build the future [b]together[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p]Once again, thank you for all your support since the very beginning.

notes.title: 🔔 One Month Until B.E.S.T's Full Release… Or Not?
notes.content: [h2]Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S ![/h2][p][/p][p]Here we are: 30 days to go before the official release of [b]B.E.S.T[/b] on [b]August 29, 2025[/b]. That’s huge for us — more than two years of development, passion, struggles, and incredible moments with all of you.[/p][p]But today, we want to take a moment to talk to you [b]openly and honestly[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/c497ef68e185e50f6d1b9c8b1ff4ebb7de801932.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📊 Development Status[/h3][p][/p][p]Episode 5 is nearly done. We're wrapping up the final scene, translations are in progress, and we're polishing the last technical adjustments.[/p][p]We’re also working hard on:[/p][list][*][p]The next episode,[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck performance,[/p][/*][*][p]Save file stability for returning players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚠️ The Challenges We’re Facing[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/d9dc2e533224cadef13d9960198a260104bbb515.png"][/img][/p][p]Lately, our biggest challenge hasn’t been technical… but [b]political[/b].[/p][p]A wave of censorship has started affecting many narrative games — especially those with adult content, even when it’s mild or story-driven.[/p][p]We’ve received multiple warning signs: reduced visibility, geo-blocking in certain countries, even sudden bans — often with [b]no clear explanation[/b] from the platforms.[/p][p]And yet, [b]B.E.S.T is far from being a porn game[/b]. It’s a story. A universe. Complex characters. A mix of romance, strategy, and social dynamics.[/p][p]But nowadays, [b]that alone is enough to trigger problems[/b], especially when the rules are vague… or just plain unclear.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧩 So What Happens Next?[/h3][p][/p][p]We’re doing everything we can to keep [b]B.E.S.T[/b] available [b]in the form you know and love — without compromise[/b].[/p][p]But let’s be honest: 🎭 The future is a bit uncertain.[/p][p]We’re exploring different options — but one thing is clear: [b]we’re not giving up[/b].[/p][p]B.E.S.T wasn’t supposed to go beyond this arc. It was a one-shot, originally. But your support, the characters, the world, and everything we’ve built together made us want to go [b]further[/b]. Deeper. Bigger.[/p][p]We’ve seen the questions on the forums about a sequel or a “Season 2.”[/p][p]Let’s clear a few things up:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]price of the game will not change[/b]. This was an Early Access project shaped by your feedback — and we’re staying true to that.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]future is uncertain[/b]. A month before launch, we don’t even know if we’ll be able to release the full version [b]without interference[/b]. So making long-term plans is risky.[/p][/*][/list][p]BUT — we’ve talked to players about what some would call a “Season 2.”[/p][p]We’re not fond of that term. If the B.E.S.T is over, then the game is over. Instead, we think in terms of [b]story arcs[/b].[/p][p]If we decide to continue the story — a new chapter, a new challenge — it would be [b]in a new, upgraded engine[/b], with proper 4K support, better features, and all the lessons learned from this development.[/p][p]We won’t be making paid DLC for B.E.S.T. It doesn’t make sense right now, especially with the risks we’re facing.[/p][p]Again: [b]we have no idea what’s coming[/b]. So for now, we’re focused on one thing only — releasing the full version.[/p][p]The rest — including a possible Episode 6 — will depend entirely on [b]how well the release goes[/b], and what [b]the platform climate[/b] looks like afterward.[/p][p]We’re even considering a [b]“censored” version for general audiences[/b], just to be safe…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/0c6964f98b80b2be510ea2785ab61fcb9dfe0aee.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 What You Can Do[/h3][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the game — if you’ve liked the story, the characters, or just the general vibe — [b]your support matters now more than ever[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Leaving a review on [b]Steam[/b], even a short one, helps a lot. We're currently at [b]79% positive[/b], and we’re just one percent away from reaching "Very Positive" — a huge milestone before launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Join us on [b]Discord[/b] and share your thoughts about what you want to see next — or how you think we should handle this situation.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]❤️ Thank You[/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you for being here. Thank you for your patience. Thank you for your feedback and trust.[/p][p]We’ve had doubts. We’ve struggled. But we’ve never stopped wanting to [b]finish this game the way it deserves[/b] to be finished.[/p][p]We’ll see you on [b]August 29[/b]. Until then, take care — and keep being the BEST 🏆[/p][p]— The Dolydev Team[/p]

[p]Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S 🌞[/p][p]I hope you’re doing great! With summer just around the corner, we wish you lots of chill evenings, fun times, and sunny adventures ahead. 😎[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44114556/06499c9e7dc88b0f0306cbb1a7267f4d8c498e5c.png"][/img]

[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]⏱ [b]A personal sprint behind the scenes[/b][/p][p]Right now, we’re juggling a lot — with [b]family commitments[/b], the [b]upcoming birth of our third child[/b], and [b]our two kids home for summer vacation[/b], every day is a race against time! 😅[/p][p]Since we don’t have a “backup team,” every single part of the game depends directly on our time and energy.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44114556/65ef5daa583148aebd57e909ca81b11949759d3c.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]💰 [b]A game fully powered by your support[/b][/p][p]This game has been entirely [b]self-funded[/b], with no public grants or external investment. It lives thanks to your early access support and your trust. ❤️[/p][p]But after [b]a year and a half of self-funding[/b], we’ve reached the point where we can’t sustain development much longer without a full release.[/p][p]So we’ve made a big decision:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/f06dcda7f0dae684787555be4478855bcb258e43.png[/img]

📖 Progress on Episode 5

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/e43cf9811f60b52b01230d16cda00f1a1b5d60f3.png[/img]

This month has been especially tough for us.

My mother passed away two weeks ago. We had to take some time to organize her funeral and be with our family.

Think of it as a tribute from us to all the moms out there.

🎉 ORIGINS 🎉

notes.title: DEVLOG 6 : EPISODE 4 !
notes.content:
**Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S!**  

A quick update on the progress of the episode!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/39d074a993c4085b4ba37dfae37a78c36ffdad4c.png[/img]  

So, the match is finally over. It was a huge part of the episode, with animations and a lot of images.  
We’ve added variations based on your choices in previous episodes (whether you trained or not, etc.), and the outcome depends on these choices… but not only that!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/f1b7ed7e1ccc443d532d124739b605f34a4075a9.png[/img]  

We’ve also completed what we talked about last time:  

**THE SPECIALIZATION TREE!**  

This system unlocks before the match and allows you to "specialize" once you reach 10 points in a chosen branch.  
For example, if you have 10 points in Sports, you can unlock the SPORTS specialization.  
During the match, there is a unique action tied to this specialization, which changes the way the match plays out.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/1d8c202b25d5168e34bf06dba75fdb3da826f57c.jpg[/img]  

So, the match has variations based on both your past choices AND the specialization(s) you have activated!  

In the next episode, we’ll be adding **talents** to these specializations. That means every 5 points, you’ll be able to unlock additional talents, which will provide extra content depending on what you activate.  

All of this helps give more weight to the stats in the game and allows for greater customization of your character!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/40c486a9a8739ed10adcb3a3218d8ab300c34de3.png[/img]  

### Now that the match is over, what’s left to do?  

- We have **2 more scenes** to complete in terms of renders and animations.  
- Translations need to be done.  
- Music and sound effects need to be integrated.  

**And that’s it!**  

We are still aiming for a release **after Steam’s March festivals and sales**.  
Once Steam provides the exact dates we can use, I’ll share more details about the episode’s release in the next update!  

Lastly, we will be doing the company’s **financial review** for this first year. I’ll share some insights on the financial side of things to remain transparent with you all!  

Alright, we still have some work left before the episode is complete, so I’ll leave you here for now! See you soon!!!  

**Dolyla**

notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY B.E.S.T !
notes.content:
Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S!

Wow, it’s already been a year since we launched our game, and what an incredible journey it’s been, all thanks to you! 🎉

[h1]Year in Review:[/h1]

    January 2024: Game launch
    March: Update with additional content for Episodes 1 and 2
    August: Release of Episode 3
    Today: Part 1 of Episode 4 is complete, and Part 2 is in progress!

Hello B.E.S.T.I.E.S!

I hope your vacation went well and you enjoyed it!

For us there were a few small "inconveniences" when episode 3 was released but everything seems to be back to normal!
For information, the phone "bug" has been fixed, the buttons now work as expected!
The Russian and Chinese translations arrived, late, but are there!

We received quite a bit of feedback on the quiz.
Some found it cool and tried hard to find all the solutions, others on the contrary found it very boring.
The goal was not to put you in difficulty on logic or general knowledge, but just to have a test based on this type of skills or knowledge because, logically, our hero takes a test to be the best student.
Don't worry, we don't plan to do any quizzes soon!

Then in terms of free-roam and story, players generally appreciated the choices offered.

As for the update time (namely that our roadmap, as it was initially established, is currently being followed), we are therefore counting on the end of the year for episode 4. We know that the wait can be a little long but overall we are not bad compared to other games of this genre. Of course some have much more content or increased quality which extends development times. But we have counted on offering you an episode every 3-4 months as you have decided. I remind you that a vote on the forum was made from the start to find out if you wanted more frequent updates (part 1 / part 2) or not. It was decided to deliver full episodes to you for more content and less testing or problems between versions etc...

I'm telling you about this because overall the rating of the game dropped in this episode for these reasons:
- Quiz too difficult 
- Development time too long
- Late translation for Russian/Chinese
- Not enough sexual content / or sexual content too difficult to find
- Game not fun enough
- ...

We take all your feedback into account and really hope to improve as we go. Once again, don't forget that the game is in early access too so we can improve it as we progress!

We also know that players are more likely to say when they don't like something than when they like something. This is also why we dose and continue more or less in the same vein!

Finally, know that the scenes of episode 4 are already organized, arranged, the choices are already prepared and the intro is already made.

Come on, let's go back because we still have work to do!

Have a good day and see you soon for the first screens of episode 4!

notes.title: DEVLOG 3 : Episode 2 Extended
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, we're at the end of the end of this update, and basically, we just have animations and translations to finish before we can give you the update for episode 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/e23f17787fad4148309b0687de0f50c23bf901fc.png[/img]

To prepare for the implementation of episode 3, we've made some purchases, and there are still others to be made:
We bought a UPS to protect our devices and a NAS to work on our data over the network. A new monitor and additional RAM (64GB instead of 32) for our main machine.

Now that we have all this... We thought it would be best to buy a second machine to do the rendering in a chain.

Indeed, we are currently doing the renders "on the fly"... That means we follow the script and place the image... press render and wait, without being able to use the computer, until the image is finished... then move on to the next one....

With images like ours, this takes between 20 minutes and 1h30 per image! Time during which we cannot use the computer. With the NAS we took, we thought about a new organization to go MUCH faster:

We prepare the images with our main computer, send the ready file to the NAS in a render queue file, the second computer retrieves this queue file and performs the images in sequence. This allows us to free up computer 1 from this task and especially not to have any waiting time during the image rendering! Since if we get ahead we just add to the queue, and otherwise we have two computers to do animations or other etc...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/1053f658675efbdcd71b1f147e79717fc9482cdd.png[/img]

So for episode 3, we're going to try to work like this once the second machine is purchased, which should drastically reduce the episode development time, also giving us more time to work on important things that players have asked for, like the minimap etc...

I'll keep you posted as soon as we receive the equipment and in the meantime, I'm going back to finish my end of episode animations (and sexy time :) ). See you soon!

Dolyla

Hello to all B.E.S.T participants!

Today a little update on where we are and where we are going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/1accdfabeeb6a3795c2b3e9107b9803236627aeb.jpg[/img]

So this week was not very productive in terms of work on the game itself but much more on meetings with lawyers, accountants, banks... The success of B.E.S.T forced us to review our company plans (basically we just wanted to remain self-employed...) and to open a development company in France... Lots of paperwork, all to better manage taxes and it's not over yet... We're still waiting the official papers to be able to open the professional bank account etc... In short...

The good news from all this is that we will be able to start working peacefully by having the funds for the small family... or even hire to support the project / start other projects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/e7e630761ea5cdc6bbacca0f7aba210b8b7e16fc.jpg[/img]
Besides that, we read all your comments and reviews of the game and we sincerely want to thank you for your opinions, whether positive or negative, because they are very important to us and above all, you give us your opinion on what you would like to find in the game, the improvements that we can make and all the optimizations that we can add! It’s really great to have your feedback and I thank you once again!

So, you gave us your opinion for the end of episode 2:

We are going to release an EPISODE 2 EXTENDED update with what we had planned for the start of episode 3!
This update will add about 20 minutes of additional content, a little lewd, a little romance and a little more action before the planned integration day for episode 3 :)
We will try to release it next month, while we finish the 2 big scenes of this update and do the translations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/ab0dfd23d0a41cdd0c29759b84e5fa707c08d4e6.jpg[/img]

In terms of improvements that would be interesting and feasible for episode 3, there are points on which we tend to agree with you:

- Add an interactive map to the game for the player's movements so that he goes to the stadium / gymnasium / class etc... and has several possible choices on the map depending on the moment in the story... Rather than to go through buttons, this would make the game more lively and dynamic and would give the player more of an impression of "playing". We will try to create this map for episode 3.

- We had overestimated the principle that players replay the game several times to see all the possible paths. Indeed, it seems that the players quickly chose their favorite and do not play another game once they have reached the end, because they are waiting for the rest of the story with her... (Grace would have a good proportion of players on this subject it seems :) ).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/ec9fc0c754c969ee266e9b2a557418421fd7c573.jpg[/img]

We are therefore going to try not to do too many parallel paths as we did from episode 1 with Red and Blue but rather to keep paths by girls by having the maximum scene length and not in parallel. I don't know if you understand what I'm writing to you but basically the choices will have an impact on the content of the scene but more on the appearance of the scene itself.

- The phone is something we have already implemented in the game but we are only using the chat function for now. We will try to use the phone better but we will do it from episode 4 for "logical" reasons from that point on in the storyline. The goal is also not to take too long to integrate new things and not to make progress on game updates...

- In terms of the events, we are going to try to implement some gameplay elements in the next ones, nothing too crazy so as not to put the players in difficulty either, but just enough to make them "participate" during an event sport by tapping the space bar to increase the shooting gauge on the next match for example... Let the player be active in the game and no longer just directed by the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/e8c3ee9b2fe497ae4dc50afdbebc95ed13412e2c.jpg[/img]

- Finally we are going to try to set up a tree of choices within the game for Episode 4, so that you can see what paths you have unlocked and what you might have missed! We say Episode 4 because it's a big feature and at the moment we have no idea how to implement it but it will give us time to research while we do Episode 3 calmly.

These are the points on which we will try to improve... If you see other important things, do not hesitate to tell us via the comments or the forums! Once again we will integrate new things gradually but this must not be at the expense of the progress of the overall story... We want to succeed in offering you between 2 and 3 complete episodes per year and let's not put additional delays on features that wouldn't add much to the game.

Well, there you have it, I wrote a big piece today! For those who are still here reading me... Thank you! And I'll see you in 2 weeks for the next Devlog which will be dedicated to this EXTENDED UPDATE!

Waiting for...
Happy Valentine’s Day everyone!

Dolyla

notes.title: 2 months before STEAM launch !
notes.content:
Hello to all! 

Yes, it's already just two months before the game's launch on Steam, and I'd like to take advantage of this countdown to tell you what's planned for the launch and beyond!

Firstly, we've decided to change the Steam banner to focus entirely on Grace because she's your favorite, and it catches the eye! 

So, here's the new official game banner (for this episode).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/4864ac8c2381d4fb83d8ece83e743d56104147e3.png[/img]

Now, let's take a step back to version 0.2.2 and Episode 2 in general. 

The episode is almost complete, with a total of 4 scenes remaining, at least 2 of which will be there for the release. These two scenes will be quite spicy 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/69d14a291c259d62aca8ed8e6d4c2b965afabb2f.png[/img]

We will also provide an additional walkthrough on Steam for players who wish to have it alongside the game.

In addition to this, we have planned an extra update one month after the release to allow time to develop what we call "extra content."

 This extra content will consist of two parts: The first part is actually a collectible card system hidden in the renders of Episode 1 and Episode 2. 

These cards will serve as the basis for a mini-game in future episodes. The game will be based on a system similar to Final Fantasy 8's Triple Triad. 

A basic starter set will be prepared to have a deck, different depending on the save, each with its own dynamics... And of course, in-game events can trigger "battles" with these decks!

 We hope to have this "starter" ready by the beginning of the year.

Here is a prototype of a card :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/ff2c7231b2e07f308ffa752d9947349f605ff8d5.png[/img]

 The second part will be 2 additional scenes added to the end of Episode 2, providing a proper conclusion to the episode before moving on to Episode 3.

All of this leaves us with a lot to finalize before the game and the extra content are released!

 I hope you still enjoy the game as much as before, and if you haven't done so already, don't forget to add it to your Steam wishlist !!! 

See you soon for information about Episode 3!

Dolyla!
